weather.summary: Chance Rain Showers then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
weather.blurb: Showers first thing, then a break from the triple digits. Take the umbrella.

air.blurb: Clear air. A great day to be outside.

lake.blurb: Close to full, good for boats and for the water supply. Down a touch this week.

pollen.blurb: A little grasses and ragweed around — most noses won't notice.

grid.blurb: A busy afternoon: demand near 83,800 megawatts, with 99,700 on hand.

sun.blurb: Twelve hours and forty minutes of daylight — long enough for a swim after work.
